args.title: Fix recent reports recipient count display to correctly handle singular and plural
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Change the recent reports listing to conditionally display "recipient" in singular form when there is exactly one recipient, as opposed to always using the plural "recipients". This improves the clarity and grammatical correctness of the dashboard display for reports sent to a single individual, such as the CFO in the Board pack example.
